maria_support: Hey team — customer report: generation requests intermittently return 401 for a single API key and the same calls succeed sometimes. They sent request_id=rc-9f3a2a7 and sample payload. Asking for repro and scrubbed logs.
liam_sre: Can you paste the exact curl they used (with key redacted) and the request_id? Also include client IP if available.
maria_support: request_id=rc-9f3a2a7, client_ip=34.120.22.11 (from headers they gave). Customer said "sometimes after ~30s the call fails with 401". Their curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","input":"summarize: ...","request_id":"rc-9f3a2a7"}'
```
liam_sre: Good. @devops-bot can you pull auth logs for that request_id and client_ip? Prefer logs ±2m of first_message time.
devops-bot: ack — queued job 7321. Fetching: auth.audit, gateway.frontend, router.trace for rc-9f3a2a7.
ahmed_engineer: If we share logs with the customer we need to scrub PII (IPs, emails, phone numbers). @kate_privacy can you confirm the scrub checklist for support repro bundles?
kate_privacy: Yes. For support bundles we require:
- replace IPs with <IP_REDACTED:n> (n=1..)
- hash any email/phone with opaque ids (sha256, first 8 chars)
- remove Authorization header values, keep header name
- redact any model input tokens that look like SSNs/CCNs
Also add a mapping file mapping opaque ids to original values stored in the ticket in internal-only view.
maria_support: Customer asked for guidance to produce their own sanitized repro. I drafted a short guide — want quick review before sending.
liam_sre: Share draft. Keep it minimal: what to capture (curl, request_id, timestamps), how to scrub keys and PII, and how to attach a debug bundle.
maria_support: Draft below:
"Steps to produce a sanitized repro bundle:\n1) Run the failing curl and capture request_id from response headers.\n2) Save full curl command and response body.\n3) Create a debug bundle: include gateway logs, client-side stderr, and a network trace.\n4) Scrub tokens: replace api keys with <REDACTED_API_KEY>, replace IPs with <IP_REDACTED:1>, replace emails with <EMAIL_HASH:abcd1234>.\n5) For any sensitive fields in the prompt, replace with placeholders and provide a redacted mapping in a separate file for internal use only.\n6) Upload bundle to the support ticket."
kate_privacy: Add explicit command for scrubbing with jq/perl. Example:
```
# redact Authorization header from curl export
sed -E 's/(Authorization: Bearer )[A-Za-z0-9\._\-\+]+/\1<REDACTED_API_KEY>/g' raw_curl.txt > scrubbed_curl.txt
# replace IPs (simple):
sed -E 's/([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/<IP_REDACTED:1>/g' gateway.log > scrubbed_gateway.log
# hash emails:
python -c "import hashlib,re,sys;print(re.sub(r'([\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+)', lambda m: '<EMAIL_HASH:'+hashlib.sha256(m.group(1).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]+'>', sys.stdin.read()))" < raw_input.txt > scrubbed_input.txt
```
ahmed_engineer: For our internal debugging we still want raw logs. Ask customer to attach both scrubbed bundle for public sharing and a private secure upload for engineering (S3 link with ACL restricted to support+eng). Provide upload path template.
maria_support: Noted. I'll include S3 upload instructions and a signed URL option.
liam_sre: Also request these server-side traces from us to correlate: gateway.frontend.trace, auth.audit for rc-9f3a2a7, and token-service logs. Run these grep commands internally:
```
grep -R "rc-9f3a2a7" /var/log/redwood/* | sed -n '1,200p'
rg 'rc-9f3a2a7' /srv/logs --no-line-number
```
devops-bot: Delivered logs to ticket (internal-only). Found 2 auth.audit entries: one success at 2024-09-01T18:12:23Z and one failure 18:12:55Z with code 401 and reason "token-expired-transient". Attached truncated stack and correlation id cor-77a4.
maria_support: I'll tell the customer we see a transient auth expiry event correlated with their request_id; ask them to rotate key and repro. Also request their SDK version and if they use clock skew corrections.
kate_privacy: Reminder — when we share the failure reason to the customer, avoid internal error strings that reveal implementation details. Use neutral phrasing: "intermittent authentication failures likely due to token expiry; we're investigating." Keep cor-** IDs internal.
maria_support: OK. I'll send the sanitized repro template + curl scrub commands and request private upload for full bundle and public scrubbed bundle. Also asked customer to repro with rotated key and attach new request_id.
liam_sre: Follow-up: if repro with new key still shows same pattern, escalate to runtime team with correlation id cor-77a4 and include the private bundle.
maria_support: Sending message to customer now. Will update thread when they upload. :white_check_mark:
